title: Taean Offshore Wind Farm: OSS jacket and topside optimisation
anonTitle: Offshore substation jacket and topside optimisation, South Korea
scope: Offshore substation (OSS) jacket and topside optimisation.
challenge: The EPC contractor wanted to reduce steel and cost in the offshore substation jacket and topside structure while keeping the design within code checks.
approach: Review of the existing jacket and topside structural design.
Optimisation of member sizes and framing for the governing load cases.
Checks of the optimised design against the in-place and installation cases.
Optimised design handed over with the supporting calculations.
